items.title: Talks between the US and Iran called off because of fighting in Lebanon, officials say
items.description: Intense fighting between Israel and Hezbollah in southern Lebanon has scuttled scheduled talks between the United States and Iran. The cancellation of talks raised questions about an initial agreement to end the war in Iran.
